column1: # KiwiCaptcha ASN dataset sample, format version 1 (tab-separated).
# A free, redistributable export (a public routing-table dump or the free
# IPtoASN dataset) is the production source; this file is the versioned
# test fixture that covers the cross-language resolution vectors. It is
# read from local disk only. Accepted row shapes (fields beyond the ASN
# are ignored metadata):
#   first_ip <TAB> last_ip <TAB> asn
#   first_ip <TAB> last_ip <TAB> asn <TAB> cc <TAB> registry <TAB> allocated
#   registry <TAB> first_ip <TAB> last_ip <TAB> asn <TAB> cc <TAB> allocated
# Blank lines and #-comment lines are skipped. A row that fails
# validation (unparsable IP, mixed family, first above last, an ASN
# outside 1..4294967294) is skipped and counted as malformed.
ripencc
2001:db8:aaaa::
2620:fe::fe:fe
# Malformed rows below: skipped per-row, counted in the dataset info.
not-an-ip
